tables.name: oos_dummy
tables.description: ILLUSTRATIVE DUMMY DATA - no OOS/out-of-stock table exists in the source model yet. Uses real DEPARTMENT names and store_no values with fabricated SKU/AED/segment figures, per the brief's explicit request for a swappable placeholder pending a real OOS feed. segment: A = priority/high sell-rate, B = replenish-in-cycle (both illustrative).

tables.name: _Underperformers
tables.description: Categories where actual sales fell below P20 on the latest reported date, ranked by shortfall (actual - P50, most negative first). Derived from _CategoryAttainment.

tables.name: _AsOfDate
tables.description:
Disconnected picker for the trading day the dashboard reports on, limited to the
7 most recent days that have data. Deliberately
unrelated to Dim_Date: a real relationship would filter the sparkline down to the
single selected day, whereas the measures need the 6 days before it as well.

columns.description: 1 = most recent day, so the slicer lists newest first.

What the slicer shows: the newest day reads "Current day" so there is always an
obvious way back to today; every other day shows as dd-MMM-yyyy.

measures.name: Section Underperforming Count
measures.description:
Wide-format per-band measures for the distribution bar charts (Value-only
binding, no Legend/Category needed) -- each is a thin CALCULATE wrapper
around 'Section Band Count' with the band fixed, so the counting logic
itself is defined once and reused, not duplicated.

measures.name: Section Row Matches Filter
measures.description:
Connects the (unrelated) _PerformanceBands slicer to the Section detail
table: TRUE for every row when nothing is selected, otherwise TRUE only
for rows whose Selected Performance matches the picked band.

measures.name: Category Row Matches Filter
measures.description:
Same pattern as 'Section Row Matches Filter', using the separate
_CategoryPerformanceBands table so the Category slicer doesn't cross-sync
with the Section slicer (they'd otherwise share filter state since both
point at the same underlying Band values).

measures.name: Selected Chart Mode
measures.description: Which view the KPI card sparklines render: Actual (absolute values vs the real P20-P80 band) or vs Benchmark (deviation from that day's P50). Driven by the chart_mode_selector slicer on the disconnected _ChartMode table; defaults to Actual when nothing is selected.

measures.name: Selected As Of Date
measures.description:
The trading day the dashboard reports on, chosen via the as_of_slicer on the
disconnected _AsOfDate table. Falls back to the latest day that actually has
data, so the dashboard opens on "Current day".

measures.name: Selected Diff
measures.description:
Absolute gap to benchmark for the selected metric: actual minus P50, in the
metric's own units (currency for Sales, bills for Bills, points for Margin).
Complements [Selected vs Bench], which gives the same gap as a percentage.
Blank when no benchmark exists, matching the other Selected measures.
